items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: I believe in what Duke Ellington said, there’s only two kinds of music, good and bad.

ctx.x: I guess so. And it probably hasn’t changed all that much, has it?
No because I like to — I believe in what Duke Ellington said, there’s only two kinds of music, good and bad.
What was it like playing with Elvin Jones?
